title: add-helm-library-with-tenant-aware-init-templates-and-graceful-rollback-orchestration
author: Asha Menon
description:
Motivation: private installs need reusable, testable Helm library components for tenant-scoped init jobs and a safer rollback orchestration path that minimizes partial-bootstrap states. This PR introduces a small Helm library (templates/_init_library.tpl, templates/init-wave-helpers.yaml) that centralizes common init job patterns (credential seeding, migration dry-run, cert bootstrap) and a config-driven rollback-orchestrator hook that coordinates safe quiesce and compensating actions when upgrades fail.

What changed (summary): consolidated init templates into a library with explicit values contracts; added values.schema.json for the library and the rollback orchestrator; introduced a new hook template (templates/rollback-orchestrator.yaml) that emits a Job responsible for staged quiesce + reversible steps; wired library into redwood-private-installer umbrella chart via chart dependencies example; added unit tests for the library templates and a simple k8s manifest smoke test to validate hook ordering.

Checklist:
- [x] library templates and helpers
- [x] values.schema.json and examples/values-tenant.yaml
- [x] rollback orchestrator hook with backoff and idempotency markers
- [x] integration smoke test in charts/test/verify-init-rollout.sh
- [x] release notes entry

Compatibility/Upgrade notes: the library is additive; existing consumers continue to work. Default behavior preserves current init job timing. To opt into the orchestrator, set rollback.orchestrator.enabled=true in your values. The values.schema includes explicit deprecation notes for legacy hooks (legacyInit.enabled) to ease migration.

Testing: local helm template against k8s v1.26 and v1.27, CI runs template-lint, go-template unit tests, and the smoke shell verifier. Stage rollout was validated on an internal QA cluster with tenant-sliced installs and simulated migration failures to ensure rollback orchestrator executes compensating actions in order.

Follow-ups: add HelmChart CRD-driven gating for air-gapped image pre-warm (separate PR), and a small operator to surface init-job state in tenant CR status (tracking ENG-4201).
commits: Add Helm library scaffolding and helper templates
Introduce values.schema.json and example values for tenant-scoped init
Add rollback-orchestrator hook with staged backoff and idempotency
Wire library into umbrella chart as optional dependency in examples
Add unit tests and smoke verifier script
Fix: tighten RBAC for orchestrator job and add annotations for rollback fencing
review_comments: Diego Rivera: This looks good overall but can we avoid creating clusterrolebindings in the library by taking an RBAC template from the installer? Creating cluster-scoped RBAC in a library can surprise consumers.
Asha Menon (author): Adjusted to include a namespaced-only RBAC option and documented the trade-off. Kept a clear note in values.schema.json about the namespace-scoped mode being the safer default.
Sofia Khan: Can the rollback orchestrator be made conservative by default (no automatic delete of resources)? We should prefer quiesce + pin + manual finalizer unless opt-in.

Asha Menon (author): Orchestrator default changed to 'observe-only' for the first wave; documented opt-in steps to enable automated compensating deletes. Added test to ensure observe-only path leaves resources intact.
Liam O'Connor: Minor nit around templating style and helper naming (use 'initWave' consistently). LGTM after small rename.
Asha Menon (author): Renamed helper to initWave* and pushed fixups. CI green.
release_notes: Add Helm library providing tenant-aware init templates and an optional rollback orchestrator hook. New values.schema.json and example values included. Defaults are conservative and non-breaking. To opt into automated rollback actions, set rollback.orchestrator.enabled=true.
